ItemID: NA; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in 10.000 Days makes another intricate, heavy Tool album my first choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy sound fits, but I would prioritize the Tool albums this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would explore more Tool after 10.000 Days; the progressive heaviness strongly appeals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic aggression fits my interest in accessible heavy rock, but it is a lower priority today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Melodic vocals and heavy guitars appeal, though I am leaning toward more riff-focused music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: God Hates Us All       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The aggression fits my interest in Advance And Vanquish, but I am choosing more progressive material today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Toxicity; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose its unusual rhythms and heavy, memorable songs given my recent Tool and Disturbed listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Be Not Nobody; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Piano-led pop does not fit the heavier music I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vile       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its relentless death-metal approach feels less appealing today than the melodic heaviness in my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: No Pads, No Helmets...Just Balls; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have enjoyed some pop-punk, but this feels lighter than the heavy, intricate sound I currently want.
